card.name: Digits inside number lists and ranges
card.fires_on: A single digit right after a comma or opening bracket in a list of numbers, such as days, grades, section numbers or function arguments. Also the digit before a decimal point in a threshold.

modes.label: Digits in numbered lists
modes.description: A digit that follows a comma inside a list of days, grades, genotypes or section references.

modes.label: Digits in arguments or thresholds
modes.description: A digit inside code arguments or the leading digit of a decimal limit.
